metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: DNS ASIM parser for Gigamon V-Series Application Metadata Intelligence
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled:bool=false) {
    GigamonV2_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where isnotempty(dns_query) or isnotempty(dns_name)
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventStartTime = coalesce(todatetime(start_time), TimeGenerated),
        EventEndTime = coalesce(todatetime(end_time), todatetime(start_time), TimeGenerated),
        EventProduct = "V-Series Application Metadata Intelligence",
        EventVendor = "Gigamon",
        EventSchema = "Dns",
        EventSchemaVersion = "0.1.7",
        EventType = "Query",
        EventResult = iff(isempty(dns_reply_code) or dns_reply_code in~ ("0", "NOERROR"), "Success", "Failure"),
        EventResultDetails = coalesce(dns_reply_code, ""),
        Dvc = coalesce(generator, vendor),
        Src = coalesce(src_ip, src_ipv6, src_mac),
        SrcIpAddr = coalesce(src_ip, src_ipv6),
        IpAddr = coalesce(src_ip, src_ipv6),
        DstIpAddr = coalesce(dst_ip, dst_ipv6),
        DnsQuery = coalesce(dns_query, dns_name),
        Domain = coalesce(dns_query, dns_name),
        DnsQueryType = case(
            isnotnull(toint(dns_query_type)), toint(dns_query_type),
            dns_query_type =~ "A", int(1),
            dns_query_type =~ "NS", int(2),
            dns_query_type =~ "CNAME", int(5),
            dns_query_type =~ "SOA", int(6),
            dns_query_type =~ "PTR", int(12),
            dns_query_type =~ "MX", int(15),
            dns_query_type =~ "TXT", int(16),
            dns_query_type =~ "AAAA", int(28),
            dns_query_type =~ "SRV", int(33),
            int(null)
        ),
        DnsQueryTypeName = dns_query_type,
        DnsResponseCode = case(
            isnotnull(toint(dns_reply_code)), toint(dns_reply_code),
            dns_reply_code =~ "NOERROR", int(0),
            dns_reply_code =~ "FORMERR", int(1),
            dns_reply_code =~ "SERVFAIL", int(2),
            dns_reply_code =~ "NXDOMAIN", int(3),
            dns_reply_code =~ "NOTIMP", int(4),
            dns_reply_code =~ "REFUSED", int(5),
            int(null)
        ),
        DnsResponseCodeName = coalesce(dns_reply_code, ""),
        DnsQueryClass = case(
            isnotnull(toint(coalesce(dns_class, dns_host_class))), toint(coalesce(dns_class, dns_host_class)),
            coalesce(dns_class, dns_host_class) =~ "IN", int(1),
            coalesce(dns_class, dns_host_class) =~ "CH", int(3),
            coalesce(dns_class, dns_host_class) =~ "HS", int(4),
            coalesce(dns_class, dns_host_class) =~ "NONE", int(254),
            coalesce(dns_class, dns_host_class) =~ "ANY", int(255),
            int(null)
        ),
        DnsQueryClassName = coalesce(dns_class, dns_host_class),
        DnsFlags = dns_flags,
        DnsTtl = toint(dns_ttl),
        EventUid = id,
        Type = "GigamonV2_CL"
};
parser(disabled=disabled)
